escalations.title: proxy-addr IP spoofing — auth bypass
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker forges X-Forwarded-For header to spoof a trusted IP address, bypassing any IP-based access controls

escalations.title: handlebars — JavaScript code injection via template tampering
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker injects malicious template string that executes arbitrary JavaScript in the server process

escalations.title: tinypool — Prototype pollution leading to RCE
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker pollutes Object.prototype via crafted input, leading to arbitrary code execution in the worker pool

escalations.title: protobufjs — Arbitrary code execution via deserialization
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends crafted protobuf payload triggering arbitrary code execution during deserialization in the orchestrator

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind to Specifications/ — false-negative CI gate
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: 84 domain requirements in Specifications/ have zero implementation references. CI passes green while the entire domain spec is unvalidated. Agents reading the spec will implement conflicting code.
p1_findings.impact: Agents implementing features against Specifications/ produce code that conflicts with the actual WorkItem workflow implementation
p1_findings.recommendation: Extend traceability-enforcer.py to scan Specifications/ requirements. Fix FR-\d+ regex pattern to match actual ID formats (FR-WF-*, FR-dependency-*). Route to requirements-reviewer.

p1_findings.title: Spec–implementation divergence: Specifications/ describes a different system
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Specifications/ specifies SQLite + Feature Requests/Bugs/Cycles/Tickets (FR-001…069). Source implements an in-memory WorkItem workflow (FR-WF-001…013). Neither acknowledges the divergence — new agents will implement conflicting code.
p1_findings.impact: Any new feature added against the spec will conflict with the actual implementation, causing integration failures and wasted dev cycles
p1_findings.recommendation: Hold a spec disposition meeting: either (a) archive Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md as superseded and write a new spec for the WorkItem system, or (b) implement the full FR-001…069 domain. Route to requirements-reviewer.

p2_findings.title: FR-TMP-001…010 have zero coverage — tiered-merge-pipeline unimplemented
p2_findings.description: 10 requirements (risk classification, Playwright runner, auto-PR, AI review, auto-merge) have no implementation. E2E dir has zero test files.
p2_findings.recommendation: Either implement FR-TMP-001…010 or formally mark them as deferred in the spec.

p2_findings.title: Architecture violation — direct store calls from route handlers
p2_findings.description: Route handlers call store.* directly, bypassing the service layer. Architecture rule: 'No direct DB calls from route handlers — use the service layer.'
p2_findings.recommendation: Introduce a WorkItemService / WorkflowService abstraction. Move all store.* calls into the service layer. Route handlers call service methods only.

p2_findings.title: Traceability ID format mismatch in inspector.config.yml
p2_findings.description: Config declares pattern FR-\d+ but codebase uses FR-WF-001, FR-dependency-*, free-text. Any tool using the config pattern finds 0 matches in source.
p2_findings.recommendation: Update inspector.config.yml: traceability pattern to FR-[A-Z-]+\d+ or equivalent. Run traceability-enforcer to verify.

p2_findings.title: E2E infrastructure wired up with zero tests
p2_findings.description: playwright.config.ts is wired and cited in Verifies comments; Source/E2E/tests/ is empty.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add at least smoke tests covering the critical paths cited in Verifies comments. Or remove the E2E infrastructure until tests are ready.

form-data — CRLF injection enabling header attacks
@grpc/grpc-js — malformed requests crash server + cert validation bypass
browserslist — unbounded memory growth leading to OOM crash
nanoid — infinite loop on negative size parameters
source-map-js — event loop DoS via source maps
path-to-regexp — ReDoS via multiple route parameters

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable react-hooks/exhaustive-deps — stale closure risk
p3_findings.recommendation: Fix hook dependencies rather than suppressing the lint rule

p3_findings.title: Recently modified components with no test files
p3_findings.recommendation: Add unit tests for each component

p3_findings.title: 14 moderate CVEs in transitive dependencies (js-yaml, brace-expansion, postcss, vite, etc.)
p3_findings.recommendation: npm audit fix in all workspaces; review @babel/core, postcss, vite upgrades carefully for breaking changes

p3_findings.title: Outdated major versions: express (4→5), react (18→19), react-router-dom (6→7), pino (8→10), uuid (9→14)
p3_findings.recommendation: Plan major version upgrades; test in staging before applying. Prioritize pino and uuid (security implications).

p4_findings.title: Plans gate runs at 100% coverage but domain gate runs at 0%
p4_findings.description: Positive data point: Plans enforcer is working correctly. P4 tracking item to note the asymmetry.

p4_findings.title: 1 unlicensed transitive dependency detected
p4_findings.recommendation: Identify the unlicensed package and assess legal risk

cross_references.single_fix: Rewrite traceability-enforcer.py to (a) scan Specifications/ as well as Plans/, and (b) use a flexible ID regex that matches all real formats (FR-WF-*, FR-dependency-*, FR-TMP-*)

cross_references.root_cause: Spec maintenance debt — specifications not updated when implementation diverged
cross_references.single_fix: Spec disposition decision: archive superseded Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md, write a new spec for the WorkItem system, and track FR-TMP-001…010 implementation status explicitly

cross_references.root_cause: Insufficient request-layer hardening (no service layer + vulnerable body parsers)
cross_references.single_fix: Introduce service layer (QO-004 fix) + update body-parser and path-to-regexp; the service layer absorbs malformed request fallout that currently reaches store.* directly
